extracted.intended_audience: federal agency program managers, procurement/acquisition officials, and OMB/policy staff
extracted.subtask_description: A short erratum to OMB Circular No. A-109 (Major System Acquisitions) revising paragraph 8c to direct agencies to avoid unnecessary management layering and reporting burdens on program managers and contractors. The page reproduces the corrected wording of that paragraph.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paragraph 8c (revised) — avoid management layering and nonessential reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Each agency should preclude management layering and placing nonessential reporting procedures and paperwork requirements on program managers and contractors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This line is an erratum to OMB Circular No. A-109 (Major System Acquisitions), issued April 5, 1976, replacing the original paragraph 8c on page 6. It functions as a prescriptive requirement for agencies to streamline management structures and eliminate unnecessary reporting and paperwork burdens; no scoring, examples, or further elaboration are provided on the page.
